temperature_range: source selenium temperature of 230 3C, zinc and substrates at 4303C
summary: Monocrystalline ZnSe films were grown on GaAs and ZnS/GaAs substrates using atomic layer epitaxy (ALE) in a gas flow system. The study aimed to control the growth of monocrystalline II-VI films on GaAs and demonstrated the formation of monocrystalline ZnSe/ZnS structures. The process involved elemental metal (zinc) and selenium as precursors, with a specific temperature range for growth.
evidence: The growth of ZnSe films by atomic layer epitaxy in the gas flow environment (ALE-GF) was performed in a `Microchemistrya-type F-120 reactor... The ZnSe film growth was performed at the source selenium temperature of 230 3C, while the temperatures of zinc and substrates were both equal 4303C.
